apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: voting-app
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: postgres-credentials
  namespace: voting-app
type: Opaque
stringData:
  # Replace before deployment using an external secrets manager.
  # Do not commit real credentials to source control.
  POSTGRES_USER: "postgres"
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "REPLACE_WITH_STRONG_PASSWORD"
  POSTGRES_DB: "postgres"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: redis
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: redis
  ports:
    - name: redis
      port: 6379
      targetPort: redis
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: redis
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis
        tier: backend
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:7-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command:
            - redis-server
          args:
            - "--appendonly"
            - "yes"
            - "--save"
            - "60"
            - "1"
            - "--maxmemory"
            - "192mb"
            - "--maxmemory-policy"
            - "noeviction"
          ports:
            - name: redis
              containerPort: 6379
              protocol: TCP
          startupProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - redis-cli
                - ping
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 30
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - redis-cli
                - ping
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - redis-cli
                - ping
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
          volumeMounts:
            - name: redis-data
              mountPath: /data
      volumes:
        - name: redis-data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: redis-data
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: redis-data
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: redis
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  # Uses the cluster's default StorageClass.
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 5Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: db
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app: db
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: postgres
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: db-read
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: db
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: db
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: postgres
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: db
spec:
  serviceName: db
  replicas: 1
  podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: db
        tier: backend
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 70
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:15-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: 5432
              protocol: TCP
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: postgres-credentials
          env:
            - name: PGDATA
              value: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
          startupProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -ec
                - |
                  pg_isready -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 60
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -ec
                - |
                  pg_isready -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -ec
                - |
                  pg_isready -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 6
          lifecycle:
            preStop:
              exec:
                command:
                  - /bin/sh
                  - -c
                  - |
                    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -m fast -w stop || true
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 1Gi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
          volumeMounts:
            - name: db-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: db-data
        labels:
          app: db
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        # Uses the cluster's default StorageClass.
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 20Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vote
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: vote
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: vote
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vote
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: vote
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vote
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vote
        tier: frontend
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      initContainers:
        - name: wait-for-redis
          image: redis:7-alpine
          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -ec
            - |
              until redis-cli -h redis -p 6379 ping | grep -q PONG; do
                echo "Waiting for Redis..."
                sleep 2
              done
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 10m
              memory: 16Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: vote
          image: dockersamples/examplevotingapp_vote:latest
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
              protocol: TCP
          env:
            - name: REDIS_HOST
              value: redis
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 30
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - NET_BIND_SERVICE
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: result
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: result
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: result
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: result
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: result
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: result
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: result
        tier: frontend
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      initContainers:
        - name: wait-for-postgres
          image: postgres:15-alpine
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: postgres-credentials
          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -ec
            - |
              until pg_isready -h db -p 5432 \
                -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"; do
                echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL..."
                sleep 2
              done
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 10m
              memory: 32Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: result
          image: dockersamples/examplevotingapp_result:latest
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
              protocol: TCP
          env:
            - name: DB_HOST
              value: db
            - name: DB_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 30
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - NET_BIND_SERVICE
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: worker
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: worker
spec:
  # One worker avoids duplicate processing assumptions.
  # Scale only after verifying application concurrency semantics.
  replicas: 1
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: worker
        tier: backend
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      initContainers:
        - name: wait-for-redis
          image: redis:7-alpine
          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -ec
            - |
              until redis-cli -h redis -p 6379 ping | grep -q PONG; do
                echo "Waiting for Redis..."
                sleep 2
              done
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 10m
              memory: 16Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
        - name: wait-for-postgres
          image: postgres:15-alpine
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: postgres-credentials
          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -ec
            - |
              until pg_isready -h db -p 5432 \
                -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"; do
                echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL..."
                sleep 2
              done
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 10m
              memory: 32Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: worker
          image: dockersamples/examplevotingapp_worker:latest
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          env:
            - name: REDIS_HOST
              value: redis
            - name: DB_HOST
              value: db
            - name: DB_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
---
# Requires an installed Ingress controller.
# Replace hostnames and configure TLS certificates before deployment.
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: voting-app
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: voting-app
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-connect-timeout: "10"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "3600"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "3600"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - vote.example.com
        - results.example.com
      secretName: voting-app-tls
  rules:
    - host: vote.example.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: vote
                port:
                  name: http
    - host: results.example.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: result
                port:
                  name: http
---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: vote-hpa
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: vote
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 1
          periodSeconds: 60
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 30
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 2
          periodSeconds: 60
---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: result-hpa
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: result
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 1
          periodSeconds: 60
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 30
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 2
          periodSeconds: 60
---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: vote-pdb
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vote
---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: result-pdb
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: result
---
# Backend services are isolated from external ingress.
# Requires a CNI implementation supporting NetworkPolicy.
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: redis-network-policy
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: vote
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: worker
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 6379
  egress: []
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: postgres-network-policy
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: db
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: result
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: worker
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5432
  egress: []
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: frontend-network-policy
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchExpressions:
      - key: app
        operator: In
        values:
          - vote
          - result
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
  ingress:
    # Allow incoming traffic from the Ingress controller.
    # Restrict this further to the controller namespace/pod
    # labels appropriate for the target cluster.
    - ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 80
  egress:
    - to:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: redis
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 6379
    - to:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: db
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5432
    # Allow DNS lookups.
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
      ports:
        - protocol: UDP
          port: 53
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 53
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: worker-network-policy
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: worker
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
  ingress: []
  egress:
    - to:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: redis
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 6379
    - to:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: db
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5432
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
      ports:
        - protocol: UDP
          port: 53
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 53
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourceQuota
metadata:
  name: voting-app-quota
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  hard:
    requests.cpu: "8"
    requests.memory: 12Gi
    limits.cpu: "16"
    limits.memory: 24Gi
    persistentvolumeclaims: "5"
    requests.storage: 100Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: LimitRange
metadata:
  name: voting-app-limits
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  limits:
    - type: Container
      defaultRequest:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 128Mi
      default:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 512Mi
      min:
        cpu: 10m
        memory: 16Mi
      max:
        cpu: "2"
        memory: 2Gi
---
# Spread frontend replicas across nodes when possible.
# Apply this patch by incorporating the affinity and topology
# settings into the vote/result Pod templates if the cluster
# has multiple worker nodes.
#
# Operational prerequisites:
# - Replace all :latest images with tested immutable digest references.
# - Provision a default StorageClass with persistent storage.
# - Create the voting-app-tls Secret using a certificate manager.
# - Configure an NGINX Ingress controller and DNS records.
# - Use an external secret manager for PostgreSQL credentials.
# - Configure PostgreSQL backups and point-in-time recovery.
# - For higher database availability, use a PostgreSQL operator
#   or managed PostgreSQL rather than a single StatefulSet replica.
# - For Redis high availability, use Redis Sentinel or managed Redis.
# - Ensure the cluster has metrics-server for HPA functionality.
# - Confirm the application images support the selected security
#   contexts and the cluster's node architectures.
# - The optional Compose seed profile is intentionally excluded;
#   run seeding as a separate, explicitly triggered Kubernetes Job
#   using a separately built and published seed-data image.
